title: Multi-Index Recovery for Total-Degree Multivariate Vandermonde Matrices
summary: For multivariate polynomial bases of total degree at most n, a column of the Vandermonde matrix is identified by a multi-index of exponents. In this work, we give a direct, recursive map from the scalar column index to this multi-index, based on a prescribed ordering in which exponents of the last variable are increased at the block level and the same rule is applied recursively to the remaining variables.
